name: claude-hq-dev
description: Development checks for the hq Claude Code plugin; nothing here ships with the plugin.

scripts.validate: claude plugin validate plugins/hq && claude plugin validate .
scripts.check:scripts: bash -n plugins/hq/bin/pr-ci-wait && bash -n plugins/hq/bin/pr-merge-wait && shellcheck plugins/hq/bin/pr-ci-wait plugins/hq/bin/pr-merge-wait scripts/*.sh
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:types && npm run check:scripts && npm run validate && npm run test
